name: bidnow-realtime
description: Real-time auctions: React client, Express + Socket.IO server, shared contract

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:deploy --prefix server && npm run db:generate --prefix server && npm run db:seed --prefix server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix client
